[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-i8[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Merge-commit support for the VCS commit log[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Merge commits are first-class in every SASE commit-log surface: [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]hidden by default so the timeline shows the commits a PR contained,[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]revealable and unmistakably marked on demand, and browsable as a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]"what landed" view — with presence, counts, and diffs that stay [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]truthful in every mode.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]9[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]merge_commit_support.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202608/merge_commit_support.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-i8[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-i8/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rust core — parent ids, tolerant parser, merge summary[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core: in the sase-core repo, add parent ids to the VCS-log wire, make [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the pinned git-log parser accept both the legacy 7-field and the new [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]8-field record layout, bump the wire schema to 3, add a strict [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]merge-subject summary parser, and expose the new PyO3 bindings.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Python wire mirror and skew probes[/bold #D7AFFF]                            [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]wire[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]wire: mirror the Rust contract on the Python side — parent ids and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]schema 3 in the wire module, %P in the pinned git-log format, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tolerant golden parser, a merge-summary facade — and add the validator [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]probes that make wheel/host skew fail loudly instead of silently [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]returning zero commits.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Provider-level merge visibility[/bold #D7AFFF]                               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]provider[dim] · [dim][/dim]after wire[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]provider: introduce the three-valued merge-visibility mode, thread it [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]through the log and partition hooks so presence and ahead/behind stay [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]consistent with what is displayed, prove the partition law, and make [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]merge-commit diffs and author-time lookups work.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Collection models and the merges query key[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]collect[dim] · [dim][/dim]after provider[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]collect: carry merge visibility through the collection filters and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]commit filter-query language, including the in-memory matcher, canonical[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tokens, completions, and snapshot-coverage rules that keep live preview [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]honest.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Marking merges in every renderer[/bold #D7AFFF]                              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]render[dim] · [dim][/dim]after collect[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]render: give merges a dedicated accent, a reserved marker column that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]costs nothing when no merge is visible, a legend key, parent lines in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]full output, structured JSON fields, and a condensed pull-request [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]headline in the pretty timeline.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]sase vcs log --merges and documentation[/bold #D7AFFF]                       [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]cli[dim] · [dim][/dim]after collect[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]cli: add the -m/--merges option with its three modes, wire it through [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the vcs handler, and document the behavior and its relationship to git's[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]own merge flags.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]ACE Commits pane merge affordances[/bold #D7AFFF]                            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]tui[dim] · [dim][/dim]after render[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]tui: add the merge-visibility cycle key to the Commits sub-tab with its [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]hint, help, availability, keymap, and config entries, and make the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]detail pane and commit modal show the merge badge, parents, and a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]meaningful merge diff.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Raise the sase-core-rs dependency window[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]floor[dim] · [dim][/dim]after cli, tui[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]floor: after the core release publishes, move the sase-core-rs version [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]window in pyproject.toml to the release that carries the schema-3 [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]contract and confirm the exhaustive gate passes against the published [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]wheel.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]End-to-end acceptance against real merge history[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]verify[dim] · [dim][/dim]after floor[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]verify: exercise every mode of every surface against a real repository [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]that contains merge commits, confirm the partition law and the skew [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]probe in a live environment, and record the acceptance evidence.[/#D7D7AF]
